standard: NTRU+ specification 2026-07-10 (Final Version, KpqC Competition), §6.3 canonical decoding
provenance: Inputs are mutations of the vendored KAT records (ntru-plus-upstream.json). Every expect/ss value is what the reference's crypto_kem_enc / crypto_kem_dec returned for that input, via tools/ntru-plus-upstream-gen/negative_harness.c.

semantics.dec/reject: decapsulation must fail with an error; the reference returns 1 and ss = 0^32
semantics.dec/accept: decapsulation must succeed with shared secret ss
semantics.enc/reject: encapsulation must refuse the public key with an error; the reference returns 1 with ct = ss = 0
semantics.enc/accept: encapsulation must succeed (ct/ss are random; nothing to compare)
